question: onlybook.ai는 어떤 서비스인가요?
reference: onlybook.ai는 AI를 활용해 누구나 쉽게 책(전자책·콘텐츠)을 기획하고 집필할 수 있도록 돕는 AI 기반 책 제작 서비스입니다. 편집·수정 후 PDF 등의 형식으로 다운로드할 수 있습니다.
expected_key_points: AI book/content creation; planning and writing; edit; PDF download

question: 무료로 사용해볼 수 있나요?
reference: 네, 회원가입 시 무료 체험 크레딧이 제공되어 결제 없이 핵심 기능을 직접 경험해보실 수 있습니다. 무료 크레딧 소진 후에는 유료 플랜을 구독하시면 계속 이용하실 수 있습니다.
expected_key_points: free trial credits; no payment required; paid plan after credits are used

question: 모바일에서도 사용할 수 있나요?
reference: 별도의 앱은 제공하지 않지만, 모바일 웹 브라우저에서 이용 가능합니다. 다만 편집 작업은 PC 환경에서 이용하시는 것을 권장합니다.
expected_key_points: mobile web supported; no separate app; PC recommended for editing

question: 어떤 언어를 지원하나요?
reference: 현재 한국어, 영어, 일본어와 중국어 콘텐츠 생성을 지원하며, 서비스 화면(UI)은 한국어로 제공됩니다. 지원 언어는 지속적으로 확대될 예정입니다.
expected_key_points: Korean English Japanese Chinese generation; UI in Korean

question: 튜토리얼이나 사용 가이드는 어디서 볼 수 있나요?
reference: 로그인 후 공식 가이드 페이지 (help.onlybook.ai)에서 단계별 사용 가이드와 튜토리얼 영상을 확인하실 수 있습니다.
expected_key_points: after login; help.onlybook.ai; step-by-step guides and videos

question: 회원가입은 어떻게 하나요?
reference: 홈페이지 우측 상단의 [회원가입] 버튼을 클릭한 뒤 이메일 주소로 가입하거나, 구글 계정으로 간편 가입할 수 있습니다. 이메일 가입 시 인증 메일의 링크를 클릭하면 가입이 완료됩니다.
expected_key_points: email or Google signup; email verification link

question: 비밀번호를 잊어버렸어요. 어떻게 재설정하나요?
reference: 로그인 화면에서 [비밀번호 찾기]를 클릭하고 가입하신 이메일을 입력하면 재설정 링크가 발송됩니다. 링크는 발송 후 24시간 동안 유효합니다. 메일이 보이지 않으면 스팸함을 확인해주세요.
expected_key_points: password reset; email link; valid 24 hours; check spam

question: 이메일 인증 메일이 오지 않아요.
reference: 먼저 스팸/프로모션 메일함을 확인해주세요. 그래도 없다면 인증 화면의 [인증 메일 재발송] 버튼을 눌러주세요. 5분 이상 수신되지 않을 경우 이메일 주소 오탈자 여부를 확인하시고, 문제가 지속되면 고객센터로 문의해주세요.
expected_key_points: check spam/promotions; resend; wait 5 minutes; verify typo; contact support

question: 계정을 탈퇴(삭제)하고 싶어요. 어떻게 하나요?
reference: [설정 > 계정 관리 > 회원 탈퇴]에서 직접 탈퇴할 수 있습니다. 탈퇴 시 작업물과 남은 크레딧은 모두 삭제되며 복구되지 않으니, 필요한 결과물은 미리 다운로드해주세요.
expected_key_points: Settings > Account Management > Delete Account; works and credits deleted; irreversible; download first

question: 여러 기기에서 동시에 로그인할 수 있나요?
reference: 네, 하나의 계정으로 여러 기기에서 로그인할 수 있습니다. 다만 계정 공유(여러 명이 함께 사용)는 이용약관상 허용되지 않으며, 비정상 사용이 감지되면 이용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
expected_key_points: multiple devices allowed; account sharing prohibited; abnormal use may be restricted

question: 요금제는 어떻게 구성되어 있나요?
reference: 무료(Free), 베이직(Basic), 프로(Pro) 3가지 플랜을 제공합니다. 플랜에 따라 월 제공 크레딧, 생성 가능 분량, 다운로드 형식 등이 달라집니다. 자세한 내용은 [요금제] 페이지에서 확인하실 수 있습니다.
expected_key_points: Free Basic Pro; credits generation length download formats vary; pricing page

question: 크레딧은 무엇이고 어떻게 차감되나요?
reference: 크레딧은 AI 생성 기능을 이용할 때 사용되는 이용권 단위입니다. 콘텐츠 생성, 재생성, 이미지 생성 등 기능별로 정해진 크레딧이 차감되며, 각 작업 실행 전에 예상 차감량이 표시됩니다.
expected_key_points: credits are usage units; generation regeneration image generation; estimated charge shown before action

question: 크레딧이 남으면 다음 달로 이월되나요?
reference: 구독 플랜에 매월 제공되는 기본 크레딧은 이월되지 않으며, 별도 구매한 추가 크레딧은 구매일로부터 1년간 이월 사용이 가능합니다.
expected_key_points: monthly included credits do not roll over; purchased extra credits valid for one year

question: 구독을 해지하고 싶어요. 어떻게 하나요?
reference: [설정 > 구독 관리 > 구독 해지]에서 언제든지 해지할 수 있습니다. 해지 후에도 이미 결제된 이용 기간이 끝날 때까지는 플랜 혜택이 유지됩니다.
expected_key_points: Settings > Subscription Management > Cancel; benefits remain through paid period

question: 무료 체험 기간이 끝나면 자동으로 결제되나요?
reference: 결제 수단을 등록하지 않은 무료 체험은 자동 결제되지 않습니다. 결제 수단을 등록한 체험의 경우 체험 종료일에 자동 결제가 시작되며, 종료 3일 전 안내 메일을 발송해드립니다.
expected_key_points: no payment method means no auto-charge; registered method auto-charges at end; email 3 days before

question: 어떤 결제 수단을 지원하나요?
reference: 국내외 신용/체크카드, 카카오페이를 지원하며, 해외 사용자를 위해 페이팔 결제도 제공하고 있습니다.
expected_key_points: credit/debit cards; KakaoPay; PayPal

question: 결제했는데 크레딧/플랜이 반영되지 않았어요.
reference: 결제 반영에는 최대 10분 정도 소요될 수 있습니다. 로그아웃 후 재로그인해도 반영되지 않는다면, 결제 영수증(승인 내역)과 가입 이메일을 첨부하여 고객센터(support@onlybook.ai)로 문의해주세요. 확인 후 신속히 처리해드리겠습니다.
expected_key_points: up to 10 minutes; log out/in; receipt and signup email; support@onlybook.ai

question: 환불 정책은 어떻게 되나요?
reference: 결제 후 7일 이내에 크레딧을 전혀 사용하지 않은 경우 전액 환불이 가능합니다. 일부 사용한 경우 사용량을 제외한 금액이 환불되며, 환불 신청은 [설정 > 결제 내역] 또는 고객센터를 통해 접수하실 수 있습니다. 처리 기간은 영업일 기준 3~5일입니다.
expected_key_points: within 7 days; unused full refund; partial use deducted; payment history or support; 3-5 business days

question: 결제 영수증(인보이스)은 어디서 확인하나요?
reference: [설정 > 결제 내역]에서 결제 건별 영수증을 확인하고 PDF로 다운로드 할 수 있습니다. 세금계산서 발행이 필요한 경우 사업자 정보를 첨부해 고객센터로 요청해주세요.
expected_key_points: Settings > Payment History; receipt PDF; tax invoice via support with business info

question: 책(콘텐츠)은 어떻게 생성하나요?
reference: ① 스토리 만들기 → ② 기본 설정 → ③ 난이도 선택 → ④ 이야기 시작 순으로 진행됩니다. 생성이 완료되면 편집기에서 자유롭게 수정한 뒤 원하는 형식으로 내보낼 수 있습니다.
expected_key_points: Create Story > Basic Settings > Difficulty > Start Story; edit; export

question: 내 자료(원고, PDF 등)를 업로드해서 사용할 수 있나요?
reference: 네, PDF, DOCX, TXT 파일을 업로드하면 AI가 해당 자료를 참고하여 콘텐츠를 생성합니다. 파일당 최대 50MB, 프로젝트당 최대 10개까지 업로드할 수 있습니다.
expected_key_points: PDF DOCX TXT; 50MB per file; 10 files per project

question: 생성 결과가 마음에 들지 않으면 다시 생성할 수 있나요?
reference: 네, 페이지 단위로 재생성이 가능합니다. 재생성 시에도 크레딧이 차감되므로, 재생성 전에 프롬프트(지시문)를 구체적으로 수정하시면 더 좋은 결과를 얻으실 수 있습니다.
expected_key_points: page-level regeneration; credits charged; refine prompt first

question: 결과물은 어떤 형식으로 다운로드할 수 있나요?
reference: PDF 형식을 지원합니다. 플랜에 따라 지원 형식이 다를 수 있습니다.
expected_key_points: PDF supported; formats may vary by plan

question: 생성된 결과물의 저작권과 상업적 이용은 어떻게 되나요?
reference: 생성된 결과물의 이용 권한은 사용자에게 귀속되며, 판매·출판 등 상업적 이용이 가능합니다. 단, 타인의 저작물을 무단 업로드해 생성한 결과물에 대한 법적 책임은 사용자에게 있으니 유의해주세요.
expected_key_points: user usage rights; commercial use allowed; user responsible for unauthorized copyrighted uploads

question: 내가 업로드한 자료를 서비스가 AI 학습에 사용하나요?
reference: 아니요, 사용자가 업로드한 자료와 생성 결과물은 AI 모델 학습에 사용되지 않으며, 서비스 제공 목적으로만 안전하게 보관됩니다. 데이터 완전 삭제를 원하시면 고객센터로 요청하실 수 있습니다.
expected_key_points: uploads and outputs not used for model training; stored only for service; deletion via support

question: What kind of service is onlybook.ai?
reference: onlybook.ai is an AI-powered book creation service that helps anyone plan and write books, e-books, and other content. You can edit the generated content and download it in formats such as PDF.
expected_key_points: AI book/content creation; planning and writing; edit; PDF download

question: Can I try it for free?
reference: Yes. Free trial credits are provided when you sign up, so you can try the core features without making a payment. After the free credits are used, you can continue by subscribing to a paid plan.
expected_key_points: free trial credits; no payment required; paid plan after credits are used

question: Can I use it on a mobile device?
reference: There is no separate mobile app, but you can use the service in a mobile web browser. For editing work, a PC environment is recommended.
expected_key_points: mobile web supported; no separate app; PC recommended for editing

question: Which languages are supported?
reference: Content generation currently supports Korean, English, Japanese, and Chinese. The service interface is provided in Korean, and additional languages may be added over time.
expected_key_points: Korean English Japanese Chinese generation; UI in Korean

question: Where can I find tutorials or a user guide?
reference: After logging in, visit the official guide page at help.onlybook.ai to view step-by-step guides and tutorial videos.
expected_key_points: after login; help.onlybook.ai; step-by-step guides and videos

question: How do I create an account?
reference: Click the Sign Up button at the top right of the homepage. You can register with an email address or use a Google account. For email signup, click the link in the verification email to complete registration.
expected_key_points: email or Google signup; email verification link

question: I forgot my password. How can I reset it?
reference: Click Forgot Password on the login screen and enter the email address used for your account. A reset link will be sent and remains valid for 24 hours. Check your spam folder if the email is not visible.
expected_key_points: password reset; email link; valid 24 hours; check spam

question: I did not receive the email verification message.
reference: First check your spam and promotions folders. If it is not there, click Resend Verification Email on the verification screen. If it still has not arrived after five minutes, check the email address for typos and contact customer support if the issue continues.
expected_key_points: check spam/promotions; resend; wait 5 minutes; verify typo; contact support

question: How can I delete my account?
reference: Go to Settings > Account Management > Delete Account. Deleting the account permanently removes your projects and remaining credits, so download any required results beforehand.
expected_key_points: Settings > Account Management > Delete Account; works and credits deleted; irreversible; download first

question: Can I sign in on multiple devices at the same time?
reference: Yes, one account can be used to sign in on multiple devices. However, sharing the account with multiple people is not permitted, and access may be restricted if abnormal usage is detected.
expected_key_points: multiple devices allowed; account sharing prohibited; abnormal use may be restricted

question: What subscription plans are available?
reference: There are three plans: Free, Basic, and Pro. Monthly credits, generation limits, and download formats vary by plan. See the Pricing page for details.
expected_key_points: Free Basic Pro; credits generation length download formats vary; pricing page

question: What are credits, and how are they deducted?
reference: Credits are usage units for AI features. A set amount is deducted for functions such as content generation, regeneration, and image generation. The estimated credit cost is displayed before each action.
expected_key_points: credits are usage units; generation regeneration image generation; estimated charge shown before action

question: Do unused credits roll over to the next month?
reference: The base credits included with a subscription do not roll over. Additional credits purchased separately can be carried over and used for one year from the purchase date.
expected_key_points: monthly included credits do not roll over; purchased extra credits valid for one year

question: How do I cancel my subscription?
reference: You can cancel at any time from Settings > Subscription Management > Cancel Subscription. Your plan benefits remain active until the end of the already-paid billing period.
expected_key_points: Settings > Subscription Management > Cancel; benefits remain through paid period

question: Will I be charged automatically after the free trial?
reference: A free trial without a registered payment method will not be charged automatically. If a payment method is registered, automatic billing begins on the trial end date, and a notice email is sent three days before the trial ends.
expected_key_points: no payment method means no auto-charge; registered method auto-charges at end; email 3 days before

question: Which payment methods are supported?
reference: The service supports domestic and international credit or debit cards, KakaoPay, and PayPal for overseas users.
expected_key_points: credit/debit cards; KakaoPay; PayPal

question: I paid, but my credits or plan have not been applied.
reference: Payment updates can take up to 10 minutes. If the plan is still not applied after logging out and back in, contact support@onlybook.ai with the payment receipt or approval record and the email address used for the account.
expected_key_points: up to 10 minutes; log out/in; receipt and signup email; support@onlybook.ai

question: What is the refund policy?
reference: A full refund is available within seven days of payment if no credits have been used. If some credits were used, the used amount is deducted from the refund. Submit a request through Settings > Payment History or customer support. Processing normally takes three to five business days.
expected_key_points: within 7 days; unused full refund; partial use deducted; payment history or support; 3-5 business days

question: Where can I find my payment receipt or invoice?
reference: Go to Settings > Payment History to view each receipt and download it as a PDF. To request a tax invoice, send your business information to customer support.
expected_key_points: Settings > Payment History; receipt PDF; tax invoice via support with business info

question: How do I create a book or other content?
reference: Follow these steps: Create Story, Basic Settings, Select Difficulty, and Start Story. After generation is complete, edit the content in the editor and export it in the desired format.
expected_key_points: Create Story > Basic Settings > Difficulty > Start Story; edit; export

question: Can I upload my own manuscript or PDF as source material?
reference: Yes. You can upload PDF, DOCX, and TXT files for the AI to reference when generating content. The limit is 50 MB per file and up to 10 files per project.
expected_key_points: PDF DOCX TXT; 50MB per file; 10 files per project

question: Can I regenerate content if I do not like the result?
reference: Yes. Content can be regenerated one page at a time. Credits are also deducted for regeneration, so refining the prompt before trying again can improve the result.
expected_key_points: page-level regeneration; credits charged; refine prompt first

question: Which file formats can I download?
reference: PDF download is supported. Available formats may vary depending on the plan.
expected_key_points: PDF supported; formats may vary by plan

question: Who owns the generated content, and can I use it commercially?
reference: The user receives the usage rights to generated content and may sell or publish it commercially. However, the user is legally responsible for results created from copyrighted material uploaded without permission.
expected_key_points: user usage rights; commercial use allowed; user responsible for unauthorized copyrighted uploads

question: Does the service use my uploaded materials to train AI models?
reference: No. Uploaded materials and generated outputs are not used to train AI models and are stored only to provide the service. You can contact customer support to request complete deletion of the data.
expected_key_points: uploads and outputs not used for model training; stored only for service; deletion via support

question: onlybook.aiはどのようなサービスですか？
reference: onlybook.aiは、AIを活用して誰でも簡単に書籍、電子書籍、各種コンテンツを企画・執筆できるAI書籍制作サービスです。生成内容は編集・修正でき、PDFなどの形式でダウンロードできます。
expected_key_points: AI book/content creation; planning and writing; edit; PDF download

question: 無料で試すことはできますか？
reference: はい。会員登録時に無料体験クレジットが付与されるため、支払いをせずに主要機能を試せます。無料クレジットを使い切った後は、有料プランを契約すると引き続き利用できます。
expected_key_points: free trial credits; no payment required; paid plan after credits are used

question: モバイル端末でも利用できますか？
reference: 専用アプリはありませんが、モバイルのウェブブラウザから利用できます。ただし、編集作業はPC環境で行うことを推奨します。
expected_key_points: mobile web supported; no separate app; PC recommended for editing

question: どの言語に対応していますか？
reference: 現在、韓国語、英語、日本語、中国語でのコンテンツ生成に対応しています。サービス画面は韓国語で提供されており、対応言語は今後拡大される予定です。
expected_key_points: Korean English Japanese Chinese generation; UI in Korean

question: チュートリアルや利用ガイドはどこで確認できますか？
reference: ログイン後、公式ガイドページのhelp.onlybook.aiで、手順別の利用ガイドとチュートリアル動画を確認できます。
expected_key_points: after login; help.onlybook.ai; step-by-step guides and videos

question: 会員登録はどのように行いますか？
reference: ホームページ右上の「会員登録」をクリックし、メールアドレスまたはGoogleアカウントで登録できます。メール登録の場合は、認証メール内のリンクをクリックすると登録が完了します。
expected_key_points: email or Google signup; email verification link

question: パスワードを忘れました。どうすれば再設定できますか？
reference: ログイン画面で「パスワードを忘れた場合」をクリックし、登録したメールアドレスを入力してください。再設定リンクが送信され、送信後24時間有効です。メールが見当たらない場合は迷惑メールフォルダも確認してください。
expected_key_points: password reset; email link; valid 24 hours; check spam

question: メール認証のメッセージが届きません。
reference: まず迷惑メールやプロモーションフォルダを確認してください。届いていない場合は認証画面の「認証メールを再送信」を押してください。5分以上届かない場合はメールアドレスの入力ミスを確認し、問題が続く場合はカスタマーサポートへお問い合わせください。
expected_key_points: check spam/promotions; resend; wait 5 minutes; verify typo; contact support

question: アカウントを退会・削除するにはどうすればよいですか？
reference: 「設定 > アカウント管理 > 退会」から削除できます。退会すると制作物と残りのクレジットはすべて削除され、復元できません。必要な成果物は事前にダウンロードしてください。
expected_key_points: Settings > Account Management > Delete Account; works and credits deleted; irreversible; download first

question: 複数の端末から同時にログインできますか？
reference: はい、1つのアカウントで複数端末にログインできます。ただし、複数人でのアカウント共有は利用規約で禁止されており、異常な利用が検知された場合は利用が制限されることがあります。
expected_key_points: multiple devices allowed; account sharing prohibited; abnormal use may be restricted

question: 料金プランはどのように構成されていますか？
reference: Free、Basic、Proの3つのプランがあります。月間クレジット、生成可能な分量、ダウンロード形式などはプランごとに異なります。詳細は料金プランページで確認できます。
expected_key_points: Free Basic Pro; credits generation length download formats vary; pricing page

question: クレジットとは何ですか？どのように消費されますか？
reference: クレジットはAI生成機能を利用するための利用単位です。コンテンツ生成、再生成、画像生成など、機能ごとに定められたクレジットが消費され、実行前に予想消費量が表示されます。
expected_key_points: credits are usage units; generation regeneration image generation; estimated charge shown before action

question: 余ったクレジットは翌月に繰り越されますか？
reference: サブスクリプションに毎月含まれる基本クレジットは繰り越されません。別途購入した追加クレジットは、購入日から1年間繰り越して利用できます。
expected_key_points: monthly included credits do not roll over; purchased extra credits valid for one year

question: サブスクリプションを解約するにはどうすればよいですか？
reference: 「設定 > サブスクリプション管理 > 解約」からいつでも解約できます。解約後も、支払い済みの利用期間が終了するまではプラン特典を利用できます。
expected_key_points: Settings > Subscription Management > Cancel; benefits remain through paid period

question: 無料体験が終了すると自動的に課金されますか？
reference: 支払い方法を登録していない無料体験は自動課金されません。支払い方法を登録している場合は体験終了日に自動課金が開始され、終了3日前に案内メールが送信されます。
expected_key_points: no payment method means no auto-charge; registered method auto-charges at end; email 3 days before

question: どの支払い方法に対応していますか？
reference: 国内外のクレジットカードとデビットカード、KakaoPayに対応しており、海外ユーザー向けにPayPalも利用できます。
expected_key_points: credit/debit cards; KakaoPay; PayPal

question: 支払いをしたのにクレジットやプランが反映されません。
reference: 支払いの反映には最大10分かかる場合があります。ログアウトして再ログインしても反映されない場合は、支払いの領収書または承認記録と登録メールアドレスを添えてsupport@onlybook.aiへお問い合わせください。
expected_key_points: up to 10 minutes; log out/in; receipt and signup email; support@onlybook.ai

question: 返金ポリシーを教えてください。
reference: 支払い後7日以内で、クレジットを一度も使用していない場合は全額返金できます。一部使用した場合は使用分を差し引いて返金されます。「設定 > 支払い履歴」またはカスタマーサポートから申請でき、処理には通常3～5営業日かかります。
expected_key_points: within 7 days; unused full refund; partial use deducted; payment history or support; 3-5 business days

question: 支払いの領収書や請求書はどこで確認できますか？
reference: 「設定 > 支払い履歴」で各支払いの領収書を確認し、PDFでダウンロードできます。税務用の請求書が必要な場合は、事業者情報を添えてカスタマーサポートへ依頼してください。
expected_key_points: Settings > Payment History; receipt PDF; tax invoice via support with business info

question: 書籍やコンテンツはどのように作成しますか？
reference: 「ストーリーを作成 > 基本設定 > 難易度を選択 > ストーリー開始」の順に進みます。生成後はエディターで自由に修正し、希望する形式で書き出せます。
expected_key_points: Create Story > Basic Settings > Difficulty > Start Story; edit; export

question: 自分の原稿やPDFをアップロードして利用できますか？
reference: はい。PDF、DOCX、TXTファイルをアップロードすると、AIが資料を参照してコンテンツを生成します。上限は1ファイル50MB、1プロジェクト10ファイルです。
expected_key_points: PDF DOCX TXT; 50MB per file; 10 files per project

question: 生成結果が気に入らない場合、再生成できますか？
reference: はい、ページ単位で再生成できます。再生成にもクレジットが消費されるため、実行前にプロンプトを具体的に修正すると、より良い結果を得やすくなります。
expected_key_points: page-level regeneration; credits charged; refine prompt first

question: 成果物はどの形式でダウンロードできますか？
reference: PDF形式に対応しています。利用できる形式はプランによって異なる場合があります。
expected_key_points: PDF supported; formats may vary by plan

question: 生成物の著作権と商用利用はどうなりますか？
reference: 生成物の利用権はユーザーに帰属し、販売や出版などの商用利用が可能です。ただし、他者の著作物を無断でアップロードして作成した生成物については、ユーザーが法的責任を負います。
expected_key_points: user usage rights; commercial use allowed; user responsible for unauthorized copyrighted uploads

question: アップロードした資料はAIモデルの学習に使われますか？
reference: いいえ。アップロード資料と生成物はAIモデルの学習には使用されず、サービス提供の目的でのみ保管されます。データの完全削除を希望する場合はカスタマーサポートへ依頼できます。
expected_key_points: uploads and outputs not used for model training; stored only for service; deletion via support

question: onlybook.ai 是什么服务？
reference: onlybook.ai 是一项基于 AI 的图书创作服务，帮助任何人轻松策划和撰写图书、电子书及其他内容。生成内容可以编辑和修改，并可下载为 PDF 等格式。
expected_key_points: AI book/content creation; planning and writing; edit; PDF download

question: 可以免费试用吗？
reference: 可以。注册会员时会获得免费试用积分，无需付款即可体验核心功能。免费积分用完后，可订阅付费套餐继续使用。
expected_key_points: free trial credits; no payment required; paid plan after credits are used

question: 可以在手机上使用吗？
reference: 目前没有单独的移动应用，但可以通过手机网页浏览器使用。编辑工作建议在电脑环境中进行。
expected_key_points: mobile web supported; no separate app; PC recommended for editing

question: 支持哪些语言？
reference: 目前支持生成韩语、英语、日语和中文内容。服务界面以韩语提供，后续计划继续扩展支持语言。
expected_key_points: Korean English Japanese Chinese generation; UI in Korean

question: 在哪里可以查看教程或使用指南？
reference: 登录后，可访问官方指南页面 help.onlybook.ai，查看分步骤使用指南和教程视频。
expected_key_points: after login; help.onlybook.ai; step-by-step guides and videos

question: 如何注册账号？
reference: 点击主页右上角的“注册”按钮，可使用电子邮箱注册，也可通过 Google 账号快捷注册。使用邮箱注册时，点击验证邮件中的链接即可完成注册。
expected_key_points: email or Google signup; email verification link

question: 忘记密码了，如何重置？
reference: 在登录页面点击“忘记密码”，输入注册邮箱后会收到重置链接。链接在发送后24小时内有效。如未看到邮件，请检查垃圾邮件文件夹。
expected_key_points: password reset; email link; valid 24 hours; check spam

question: 没有收到邮箱验证邮件。
reference: 请先检查垃圾邮件和推广邮件文件夹。如果仍未收到，请在验证页面点击“重新发送验证邮件”。超过5分钟仍未收到时，请确认邮箱地址是否输入有误；问题持续时请联系客户支持。
expected_key_points: check spam/promotions; resend; wait 5 minutes; verify typo; contact support

question: 如何注销或删除账号？
reference: 可在“设置 > 账号管理 > 注销账号”中自行删除。注销后，作品和剩余积分都会被永久删除且无法恢复，请提前下载需要保留的结果。
expected_key_points: Settings > Account Management > Delete Account; works and credits deleted; irreversible; download first

question: 可以同时在多台设备上登录吗？
reference: 可以，一个账号可在多台设备上登录。但不允许多人共享账号；如检测到异常使用，服务可能会限制账号访问。
expected_key_points: multiple devices allowed; account sharing prohibited; abnormal use may be restricted

question: 有哪些套餐？
reference: 提供 Free、Basic 和 Pro 三种套餐。每月积分、可生成内容量和下载格式等会因套餐而异。详情请查看套餐页面。
expected_key_points: Free Basic Pro; credits generation length download formats vary; pricing page

question: 积分是什么？如何扣除？
reference: 积分是使用 AI 生成功能时消耗的使用单位。内容生成、重新生成、图片生成等功能会按各自规则扣除积分，并在执行操作前显示预计扣除量。
expected_key_points: credits are usage units; generation regeneration image generation; estimated charge shown before action

question: 未使用的积分可以结转到下个月吗？

expected_key_points: monthly included credits do not roll over; purchased extra credits valid for one year

question: 如何取消订阅？
reference: 可随时在“设置 > 订阅管理 > 取消订阅”中取消。取消后，在已支付的使用期限结束前仍可继续享受套餐权益。
expected_key_points: Settings > Subscription Management > Cancel; benefits remain through paid period

question: 免费试用结束后会自动扣费吗？

expected_key_points: no payment method means no auto-charge; registered method auto-charges at end; email 3 days before

question: 支持哪些支付方式？
reference: 支持境内外信用卡和借记卡、KakaoPay，并为海外用户提供 PayPal 支付。
expected_key_points: credit/debit cards; KakaoPay; PayPal

question: 已经付款，但积分或套餐没有生效。

expected_key_points: up to 10 minutes; log out/in; receipt and signup email; support@onlybook.ai

question: 退款政策是什么？

expected_key_points: within 7 days; unused full refund; partial use deducted; payment history or support; 3-5 business days

question: 在哪里查看付款收据或发票？
reference: 可在“设置 > 支付记录”中查看每笔付款的收据，并下载为 PDF。如需开具税务发票，请附上企业信息向客户支持提出申请。
expected_key_points: Settings > Payment History; receipt PDF; tax invoice via support with business info

question: 如何创建图书或其他内容？
reference: 依次执行“创建故事 > 基本设置 > 选择难度 > 开始故事”。生成完成后，可在编辑器中自由修改，并导出为所需格式。
expected_key_points: Create Story > Basic Settings > Difficulty > Start Story; edit; export

question: 可以上传自己的稿件或 PDF 作为资料吗？

expected_key_points: PDF DOCX TXT; 50MB per file; 10 files per project

question: 不满意生成结果时可以重新生成吗？

question: 可以下载哪些文件格式？

expected_key_points: PDF supported; formats may vary by plan

question: 生成内容的版权和商业使用规则是什么？

question: 服务会使用我上传的资料训练 AI 模型吗？

expected_key_points: monthly included credits do not roll over; purchased extra credits valid for one year

question: 付款已经5天，而且用了一点积分，这种情况还能退款吗？
reference: 付款后7天内，如果完全没有使用积分，可以全额退款。如果已使用部分积分，将扣除已使用部分后退款。可通过“设置 > 支付记录”或客户支持提交申请，通常需要3至5个工作日处理。
expected_key_points: within 7 days; unused full refund; partial use deducted; payment history or support; 3-5 business days

question: 可以上传 PDF 或 Word 稿件来制作图书吗？请说明文件大小和数量限制。
reference: 可以。上传 PDF、DOCX 或 TXT 文件后，AI 会参考这些资料生成内容。每个文件最大50MB，每个项目最多上传10个文件。
expected_key_points: PDF DOCX TXT; 50MB per file; 10 files per project

question: 我上传的稿件会被用于 AI 训练吗？需要时可以彻底删除吗？
reference: 不会。用户上传的资料和生成结果不会用于训练 AI 模型，只会为了提供服务而安全保存。如需彻底删除数据，可联系客户支持提出申请。
expected_key_points: uploads and outputs not used for model training; stored only for service; deletion via support
